reason: Only int4-g128 met observed quality, but at 2299 MiB; the lower-memory 3-bit and mixed 3/4-bit trials missed the 95% gate. With two trials, prioritize untested smaller group sizes for 3-bit uniform and mixed recipes: smaller groups may improve quantization accuracy, while memory and throughput effects are unknown. Rank g32 and g64 variants first as hypotheses for a quality-safe memory reduction. The evidence does not establish BF16 throughput retention for any recipe, and no recipe is known to pass both gates.
